finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/notes/yorkie-note-store.ts::setlocalselection folding into an open batch's ambient presence has no test
evidence: The new branch at yorkie-note-store.ts (`if (this.activeRoot && this.activePresence) { publish(...); return; }`, ~line 186) plus the `activePresence` field are added in this diff, and neither test file that touches YorkieNoteStore exercises it: yorkie-note-store.test.ts (shown in full) never calls `setLocalSelection`, and the four cases in notes-undo-integration.test.ts assert only text/undo-stack state, never presence or peer selections. The mounted-editor tests do reach `setLocalSelection` indirectly through the remote-selection plugin, but that runs after NoteSyncPluginValue.update has already closed its synchronous `store.batch()` (and jsdom has no focus, so it takes the `head === null` no-op path), so `activeRoot`/`activePresence` are null there — the folding path itself is never entered or asserted. The other `setLocalSelection` references in the diff are stubs in note-sync/remote-selection/memory tests, not the Yorkie store. Impact is limited: this is a defensive path guarding against a nested `doc.update`, and Yorkie publishes local-change events after `update()` returns, so it is rarely (if ever) hit in practice — hence minor rather than major.
